newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PHILIPS' ORIGIN UNIT'S CEO BUTLER TO QUIT.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS' ORIGIN UNIT'S CEO BUTLER TO QUIT.

text.p: Dutch information technology group Origin, a unit of Philips Electronics NV, said on Monday its Chief Executive Officer Tom Butler would step down from his position, effective August 31.
Origin said in a statement Butler had "relinquished his position...in order to pursue interests outside the company."
According to Origin's 1996 annual report, Butler joined Origin on June 1, 1996 as chief operating officer and has been chief executive officer since November 7, 1996.
Origin, headquartered like Philips in Eindhoven, provides information technology services throughout the world.
